app.title: Sampark
land.hero_body: People who cannot speak or hear are still shut out of the simplest thing: a phone call. Sampark turns the clerk’s voice into live captions and ISL (Indian Sign Language) depiction, you tap a reply suggestion, and only Send speaks — in Hindi or English.
land.lead: You lead. Sampark carries the conversation.
land.lead_body: Every signal that matters is on screen — captions, ISL, and the line state — so you are never guessing what is happening on the line.
land.shape: See the shape of every conversation.
land.shape_body: A phone call is more than a transcript. Captions, ISL depiction, connection, silence and the number worth keeping are clear on screen — and every call is saved when it ends.
land.depend: Calls should not depend on being able to speak or hear.
land.why_1: See captions and ISL on screen, and whether the line is active, silent, or disconnected — a deaf user cannot hear hold music.
land.why_2: Reply suggestions stay suggestions. Nothing is spoken until you tap Send.
land.why_3: The outcome card keeps the complaint number on top. The full conversation stays collapsed.
land.footer: A phone relay for deaf and non-verbal India
land.step1_title: Enter only the facts this call needs
land.step1_body: Pick a situation first. Then add consumer number, area, or bank details — only what you typed. Sampark will not invent a number or a name.
land.step2_title: Read every word — and see it signed
land.step2_body: The clerk’s voice becomes live captions and an ISL avatar. A silence ring shows whether the line is active, quiet, or gone.
land.step3_body: Nothing is spoken until you approve the exact sentence. OTP, PIN, CVV and passwords are never spoken.
land.tl1_body: Sampark opens the line. The first sentence names you as an assistive relay.
land.tl2_body: You read the line, watch the ISL depiction, tap a reply suggestion, and press Send.
land.tl3_body: Pin it when you hear it. The outcome card keeps that number on top.
setup.title: Setup
setup.heading: Before you call
setup.intro:
Who you are and how Sampark should talk for you.
Situation related facts and ISL will be needed when you start a call for a better experience.
setup.name_hint: Spoken in the first line of every call, with “I am speaking through an assistive relay.”
setup.ui_language_hint: Choose this first so the rest of setup is easy to read.
setup.access_need_hint: One tap. This shapes how we introduce you — not call details.
setup.access_hearing: I am deaf or hard of hearing
setup.access_both: I have difficulty hearing and speaking
setup.call_language_hint: What the clerk hears on the phone. Separate from app language. Hindi or English only.
setup.voice_hint: How you sound to the clerk. Tap Play — ask someone nearby to listen if you cannot hear the sample.
setup.preview_failed: Could not play this sample. Try again in a moment.
start.title: Start a call
start.goal: Get a complaint number for the power cut
start.need_name: Add your name in setup first.
call.captions_failed: Live captions could not start. Type the clerk line, or try again.
call.mic_needed: Microphone blocked. Type the clerk line, or allow the mic for live captions.
call.otp_blocked: Sampark will not speak codes. Unmute to say it yourself.
failure.silent_clerk_desc: The line has been quiet or on hold.
failure.refused_desc: The clerk has refused or cannot fulfill this request.
call.selected_hint: This is exactly what Send will speak.
call.pick_suggestion: Tap a reply suggestion, then Send.
call.isl_error: Avatar could not load. Gloss still appears below.
call.ringing_hint: Waiting for the clerk desk to come online — like waiting for them to pick up.
call.waiting_greeting: On the line. The distress message will speak when they greet you.
call.waiting_caller_hint: The caller is not connected yet. Keep this desk open.
outcome.title: Call outcome
outcome.no_outcome: No call on this phone yet.
outcome.save_facts: Save these facts for next time
start.facts_hint: Only what this helpline needs. Type or tap Speak. You can save them after the call.
start.isl_hint: You can turn this on or off again during the call.
start.brief_hint: Say what to cover before the call. It is added to your first Send draft — Sampark never speaks until you tap Send.
start.brief_placeholder: e.g. 'Report power outage in Sector 4 since 2 PM, meter 994021. Medical equipment in use, please expedite.'
start.brief_mic_error: Could not use the microphone. Type the issue, or allow the mic and try again.
start.brief_captions_error: Live captions could not start. Type the field, or try Speak again.
setup.location_hint: Area or landmark. Used first in emergencies. You can still allow GPS when you tap SOS.
start.sos_hint: 112 now — police, fire, ambulance, disaster. Speaks your location in one tap.
call.desk_hint: Place the phone facing the counter. Captions are large. Send speaks toward them.
call.one_tap_hint: Emergency only: tap a phrase and it speaks immediately. The exact sentence is shown in the draft.
